## Next modernization module: analogue A0 contract prepared — 2026-11-04

Following the finite encoder E2 PASS under #8, the investigator requests preparing the next contract. Reuse this existing product/modernization issue and consumer https://github.com/uibcdf/peptidemt/issues/32; no new issue is opened. This update is a **proposal for review**, not A1 implementation or trained-model authorization.

### First scope recommended

Native-score **improvement**: explicit seed, positive attempt count and finite nonnegative dimensionless temperature; original latent Gaussian perturbation, conditions [1,1], deterministic softmax and strict improvement of both native heads. No optional sequence filters, discovery, descriptors or PCA in this first composer. Subsequent original functions remain in the full-modernization programme.

Model-token input: nonempty CPU int64 [B,25], canonical nonempty post-padded rows, preserving every duplicate prototype occurrence. Reject invalid/internal-zero/all-zero prototype rows and wrong shape/type/device; no silent string repair/truncation or new molecular parser. MolSysMT retains general molecular/file transport; HydrAMP owns its native token semantics and learned operations.

Preserve native attempt-major order row a*B+i and separate encoder batches B for scale / B*A for means. Local MT19937 draws the original scaled normal without changing caller RNG state; retain float64 noise/conditioned values until the FP32 decoder boundary. Scale is exp(raw_log_variance/2), not variance itself. No clipping, hidden retries/refill or invented score epsilon.

Per future call: two encoder evaluations, two prototype heads, one decoder and two generated heads = **seven neural evaluations**. A paired-head Python API does not reduce the number of networks. This is future accounting, **zero analogue calls are authorized now**.

Return an ordered primary record per prototype occurrence plus all-attempt trace, including rejected rows, raw tokens, actual noise, scores and returned/exclusion mappings. Preserve native self-exclusion and lexical within-bucket deduplication with the first accepted attempt's scores. The primary occurrence-preserving output deliberately differs from the original lossy sequence-keyed dictionary; no universal portable schema is adopted.

### Source findings requiring product review

Frozen original `6590d2f4c2963f25d30669052a4c4a857e0e7279`, unchanged `amp/`:

1. `_transpose_sequential_results` lines110–119 keys by prototype string and overwrites earlier equal prototypes, which may have independently perturbed candidate pools.
2. Original README describes lower P(MIC) for improvement, while analogue lines322–324 require strict higher `mic`; the same README labels it probability of low MIC. Preserve actual larger-is-better low-MIC-class score semantics, without calling it measured MIC or biological improvement.
3. The README's two-prototype example omits the comma between adjacent string literals. Copied as Python it concatenates them, interacting with native pre-truncation for overlength prototypes.
4. The softmax advice overlooks that different attempts have distinct perturbed latent inputs; deterministic decoding alone does not make them identical.

These are **static source/documentation observations**, not newly executed failures or biological measurements. Optional mask/dispatch defects already belong to #7 and are not re-tested/fixed here. First scope rejects enabled optional filters instead of silently copying or repairing them.

### Gates and exact maintained record

Owner proposal: `devguide/pytorch_analogue_work_order.md` in the current encoder worktree, SHA-256 `11c1a85ec9233ba5a09ee18be377d41a577831793b9d7b7a2eef817a3415d360`. Owner evidence: `devguide/evidence/pytorch_analogue_preparation.json`. Consumer review: `devguide/hydramp_analogue_work_order.md`.

A1 requires explicit contract approval before separate-candidate implementation and bounded artificial math/policy/RNG/occurrence/installed tests. Synthetic oracle atol=2e-6/rtol=2e-5 is proposed for predeclared bounded formulas, not pretrained acceptance. A2 needs exact candidate/assets/input/seed/temperature/attempt cases, prospective criteria, actual reference sampling/loading/descriptor accounting and fresh finite host/call approval. Original get_sigma's three-output graph is not automatically covered by E2's two-output reference. Discovery/descriptors/optional filters/transport follow independently.

No framework import, parameter-array read/re-hash, model/PCA/descriptor/Macrel call, mathematical test, new artifact/candidate, commit/push/release or original-author contact occurs in A0. Dev3/dev4 runtime and wheel identities, D35/M1–M8/selectors and all prior FAILs remain unchanged. Retain preparation resources through 2026-11-14.

## Analogue A0 contract prepared; A1 approval pending — 2026-11-04

Owner proposal/product findings: https://github.com/uibcdf/hydramp/issues/4#issuecomment-6635761105. Optional mask/dispatch defects retain their existing owner uibcdf/hydramp#7; no new issue is opened.

The investigator requests the next work order after finite encoder E2. The maintained consumer record is `devguide/hydramp_analogue_work_order.md`; exact source/proposal evidence is `devguide/evidence/hydramp_analogue_preparation.json`.

Recommend a first route for **strict improvement of both original native AMP/low-MIC-class scores**, with explicit local seeded Gaussian latent perturbation, dimensionless temperature/attempt count, original conditions [1,1] and deterministic softmax. No optional sequence filters, discovery, descriptors or PCA in the first composer. Those functions remain later reviewed parts of full modernization.

The primary result preserves every prototype occurrence and every attempted candidate/score/exclusion mapping. This deliberately avoids the original sequence-keyed dictionary overwriting earlier equal prototypes. Retain native self-exclusion and lexical within-bucket deduplication; native scores are not biological improvement, measured MIC, hemolysis or either current PeptideMT selector.

Source inspection also identifies original README MIC-direction wording inconsistent with the method, a missing comma concatenating prototype literals, and softmax attempt advice overlooking distinct latent perturbations. These are source findings under the existing product review, not newly executed model failures.

HydrAMP owns/reuses encoder, decoder, paired native-head operations and native token semantics. General molecular/file handling stays MolSysMT-owned; PeptideMT keeps design/orchestration, attribution responsibilities and its current Macrel selectors. No new parser, schema or model is implemented in PeptideMT.

**A1 implementation with artificial parameters only requires contract approval.** A later A2 real campaign gets an exact candidate/bundle/input/RNG/call plan and fresh host limits. Seven neural evaluations per future analogue call are identified, but no analogue call is authorized by A0. E2's allowance is exhausted.

Preparation reads source only: zero framework imports, parameter-array opens/re-hashes, mathematical/model/PCA/descriptor/Macrel calls or new downloads. Dev3/dev4 source/wheels, prior FAILs and D35/M1–M8 remain unchanged. No new D-number, trained execution, analogue/training implementation, release or author contact is inferred. Keep this consumer record partial/open.
